review_candidates.description: I’m working with a leading multidisciplinary engineering consultancy looking to appoint a Senior Civil Engineer within its growing Buildings team in Perth. This is a particularly strong opportunity for a technically capable Civil Engineer who wants more than another Senior Engineer position. The role offers a genuine pathway into a Project Technical Lead / leadership position as the Perth team continues to grow. The Opportunity You’ll take ownership of the civil engineering delivery associated with major building projects across sectors including healthcare, defence, commercial, education and industrial . This is a hands-on technical leadership role , rather than a pure project management position. You’ll remain involved in design and technical decision-making while taking greater responsibility for project delivery, client relationships and mentoring junior engineers and designers. Your responsibilities will include: Leading site civil design across earthworks, stormwater/drainage, site grading, servicing, pavements and car parks Delivering projects from feasibility and concept design through to construction support Coordinating civil design with architects, structural, hydraulic and other building services disciplines Managing project budgets, programmes and technical quality Reviewing drawings, reports, specifications and authority submissions Supporting and mentoring junior engineers, designers and drafters Building strong relationships with clients and key stakeholders Contributing to the continued growth of the Civil capability in WA What We’re Looking For Ideally, you’ll bring: 7–10+ years’ civil engineering consulting experience Strong experience delivering site civil works associated with building projects Technical capability across earthworks, drainage/stormwater, grading, water and sewer servicing Experience coordinating civil design around building footprints, finished floor levels, basements and car parks Experience managing multiple projects and taking ownership of delivery Knowledge of Australian Standards and WA authority requirements Experience across the full project lifecycle Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills Experience mentoring more junior team members Working knowledge of DRAINS, 12D and AutoCAD/Civil 3D Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent Chartered status, or progress towards Chartership, will be highly regarded Candidates coming from broader land development or infrastructure backgrounds may also be considered where they can demonstrate strong, transferable site-civil experience. Why Consider This Opportunity? The biggest differentiator is the career pathway . The business is looking for someone who can initially come in as a strong Senior Civil Engineer but progressively take on greater technical and team leadership responsibility as the Perth capability expands. For someone already operating at Lead or Principal level , there is also scope to consider appointment at a higher level where the appropriate technical and leadership experience can be demonstrated. You’ll also gain exposure to a diverse portfolio of significant WA projects while joining an established multidisciplinary consultancy with the resources and project pipeline to support your longer-term progression. Interested? Apply via LinkedIn or reach out to me directly for a confidential discussion.
